jobs.description:

**Why USAA?**


At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the \#1 choice for the military community and their families.


Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.


We are proud to support active\-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active\-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

**The Opportunity**


USAA is seeking a Director, Information Technology to lead the strategy, delivery, and evolution of telematics technology capabilities supporting Auto and Property \& Casualty Insurance. This leader will drive the development of scalable cloud\-based data platforms, telematics products, and strategic partnerships that transform driving behavior and connected vehicle data into meaningful business outcomes. The ideal candidate brings deep experience in insurance technology, telematics ecosystems, and modern data platforms, combined with a passion for innovation, talent development, and delivering member value.

  

As a technology leader, you will partner across engineering, product, data science, and business teams to advance usage\-based insurance and telematics capabilities. You will help shape the future of connected insurance by leveraging cloud technologies, advanced analytics, and strategic industry partnerships to improve pricing, risk assessment, claims insights, and member experience.

  

We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be **in the office 4 days per week.** This position can be based in one of the following locations: San Antonio, TX, or Plano, TX. Relocation assistance is **not** available for this position.

* Develops and oversees metrics for technology support capabilities and/or processes (KPIs, KRIs, etc.).
* Creates a multi\-year plan to operationalize a technology support strategy, with key milestones, deliverables, and realization targets.
* Oversees the creation and execution of departmental budgets and forecasts for applicable technology support function.
* Oversees the availability management of technology solutions / domains by applying strong change and incident management practices.
* Works across multiple functional areas and influences future business strategy to be able to best utilize available technology support functions as well as future ones.
* Stays abreast of industry trends and understands the direction of applicable technology support capabilities and ensures technology environment is agile enough to change quickly to support.
* Builds successful stakeholder relationships with other IT and business leaders by developing a clear understanding of business needs, acting as a trusted advisor, and ensuring cost\-effective delivery of technology support services to meet those needs.
* Participates in the development of 3rd Party vendors strategy and provides oversight to ensure achievement of technology support objectives.
* May provide oversight of vendor management activities including service agreements, staff augmentation and technology contracts.
* Builds and oversees a team of employees for assigned functional area through ongoing execution of recruiting, development, retention, coaching and support, performance management, and managerial activities.
* Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

* 8\+ years of experience in a technology function within Software Engineering, Application Development, Data Engineering, or Infrastructure environments.
* Experience designing, building, and scaling cloud\-based data platforms that ingest and process high\-volume data streams using AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience partnering with insurance telematics providers (e.g., Arity, Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT), Octo) and/or vehicle OEMs.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) is responsible for leading the company’s overall technology strategy, infrastructure, product development, cybersecurity, and technical operations. The CTO will align technology initiatives with business objectives, drive innovation, build high\-performing engineering teams, and ensure the company maintains scalable, secure, and reliable technology systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

\* Develop and execute the company’s long\-term technology strategy and roadmap.

\* Lead technology, engineering, software development, IT, data, and cybersecurity functions.

\* Translate business goals into effective technology solutions and initiatives.

\* Oversee the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of software products and platforms.

\* Establish scalable technology architecture and infrastructure.

\* Ensure systems are secure, reliable, high\-performing, and cost\-effective.

\* Lead digital transformation and adoption of emerging technologies, including AI and automation.

\* Establish technology standards, development processes, and best practices.

\* Manage technology budgets, vendors, technology investments, and resource allocation.

\* Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain senior technical talent.

\* Work closely with the CEO, COO, CFO, CPO, and other executives on strategic initiatives.

\* Identify and manage technology risks, cybersecurity threats, and compliance requirements.

\* Establish KPIs and performance metrics for technology teams and initiatives.

\* Evaluate new technologies, platforms, tools, and strategic partnerships.

\* Ensure business continuity, disaster recovery, data protection, and system availability.

\* Communicate complex technical concepts and technology strategy to executive leadership and stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

\* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

\* Master’s degree or MBA is preferred.

\* \*10\+ years of experience\* in technology, software engineering, IT, or a related field.

\* \*5\+ years of leadership/management experience\*, preferably at a senior or executive level.

\* Proven experience developing and executing technology strategies.

\* Experience leading engineering or technology organizations.

\* Strong understanding of cloud computing, software architecture, cybersecurity, databases, APIs, and modern development practices.

\* Experience managing technology budgets and large\-scale projects.

\* Strong knowledge of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, and software development lifecycle practices.

**Preferred Skills**

\* Strategic leadership and business acumen

\* Software and systems architecture

\* Cloud platforms and infrastructure

\* Artificial intelligence and machine learning

\* Cybersecurity and risk management

\* Data analytics and technology governance

\* Product development

\* Digital transformation

\* Vendor and partner management

\* Budget and resource management

\* Executive communication and presentation

\* Change management

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

\* Technology uptime and system reliability

\* Product development and delivery timelines

\* Technology cost efficiency

\* Cybersecurity and compliance performance

\* Engineering productivity

\* Product quality and customer experience

\* Successful implementation of technology roadmap

\* Employee retention and development within technology teams

\* Innovation and adoption of strategic technologies

Join us as our Chief Technology Officer to lead transformative projects that redefine our technological capabilities! We value energetic leaders who are passionate about shaping the future through innovative solutions while ensuring security integrity across all platforms. This is your chance to influence strategic decisions at the highest level—driving growth through cutting\-edge technology!

Work Location: Remote
